transformations.heading: Real People, Real Results - Success Stories That Motivate

stories.name: Vikram Singhania
stories.quote: With 12-hour desk shifts, I thought fat loss was impossible. Asif built my meal plan around ghar ka khana and 40-min home workouts. Lost 15kg without giving up evening chai!

stories.name: Pooja Hegde
stories.quote: Coach Asif altered my carb timing and resistance training. My cycles became regular, my energy returned, and I dropped 3 dress sizes without crash dieting.

stories.name: Dr. Anirudh Mehta
stories.quote: As a doctor with irregular hospital shifts, Asif's WhatsApp support and flexible meal prep made consistency effortless.

stories.name: Rajesh & Sneha
stories.quote: We joined together as busy parents. Asif taught us how our entire family can eat wholesome, tasty meals while shedding stubborn fat.
